title: aster shortii subsp. azureus
intro: Aster shortii subsp. azureus, commonly known as azure blue aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb that grows in the wild and is native to the southeastern United States. The azure blue aster has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress due to its therapeutic actions of acting as a nervine and sedative. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its reported health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
